svg.text: ⚡ Pablo Diego Pereira — Career Narrative & Executive Bio
Economist graduated from the Federal University of
Rio de Janeiro (UFRJ) and Wealth & Investment
Advisor accredited by ANCORD under CVM Resolution
178. As a partner at Meta Investimentos, he works on
asset allocation, quantitative risk modeling, and
regulatory compliance, serving clients nationwide
with a regional presence in Região dos Lagos/RJ
(Araruama and Rio das Ostras).
He holds an MBA in Data Science and Analytics from
USP/ESALQ and is a Master's candidate in Production
Engineering and Computational Systems at Fluminense
Federal University (UFF/MESC), where he researches
Operations Research and Combinatorial Optimization
applied to statistical arbitrage and portfolio
selection on B3.
His prior background spans qualitative and
quantitative market research, public opinion
analysis, and analytics engineering, including the
technical design of the FieldCopilot platform.
